module.purpose: Defines event interfaces and a manager class for collection lifecycle events in a database abstraction layer. Exports typed event contracts and a fluent event emission API.
module.summary: This module defines TypeScript interfaces for various collection lifecycle events (status changes, subscriber changes, loading state, truncation, and index operations) and provides the CollectionEventsManager class that extends EventEmitter to emit these typed events. The design uses template literal types for event type discriminators and mapped types for comprehensive event union types.
module.businessContext: Manages real-time collection state notifications for database subscribers. Critical for reactive UI updates and cache invalidation. Failure breaks subscription consistency and event-driven workflows.
classes: CollectionEventsManager (~L111-185): Event manager extending EventEmitter for typed collection events

detail.name: CollectionEventsManager

postconditions: All specified event listeners will be notified with the correctly typed event payload.

Emitting an event with no registered listeners is a no-op.

detail.signature: emitStatusChange<T extends CollectionStatus>(status: T, previousStatus: CollectionStatus): void
preconditions: The collection instance must be set on the manager.
postconditions: A 'status:change' event is emitted to all listeners with the specified payload.
edgeCases: If the new status equals the previous status, the event is still emitted.
If the collection instance is not set, the method may throw when accessing `this.collection`.
